# Security

xGEO is a game and a teaching simulation. It has no servers, accounts or
network code of its own; the web build runs entirely in the browser.

If you find a security problem (for example in the web build, the build
tools, or a dependency), please report it privately through GitHub's
"Report a vulnerability" button on this repository's Security tab rather than
in a public issue. We aim to reply within a week.

## Scope of the simulation

xGEO Core models from public sources only (see `core/docs/REALISM-SOURCES.md`).
Please do not submit classified, export-controlled or otherwise restricted
information, parameters of real military systems that are not public, or
anything you are not free to publish.
